title: Completed boundary equation with shared category interfaces
statement: For categories C,D, U:C→D, objects W,X,Y of C and Z of D, g:W→X, delta:X→Y, z:U(Y)→Z and v:U(W)→Z, completedBoundaryEquation(U,g,delta,z,v) is U(g≫delta)≫z=v. This is a real definition of the composite equation, with no assertion that it holds.
